explanation: Each parallel branch connects directly across the supply, so every lamp receives the full mains voltage and can be switched on or off without affecting the others — which is why homes are wired this way.

options.text: A share of the voltage that shrinks with every extra branch
Half the mains voltage, shared with the next branch
No voltage until all the other branches are switched off
The full mains voltage, whichever other branches are on or off
